title: Cowboys will not negotiate long-term deal with WR George Pickens by July 15 deadline

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys will not negotiate long-term deal with WR George Pickens by July 15 deadline
sources.description: Leaving Pickens under the franchise tag is not how many teams would do business. But the Cowboys only traded for Pickens last May and want a larger sample size of his production and off-field leadership.
